description: Description Circuit Optimization Challenge is a hands-on quantum computing competition focused on improving the efficiency of quantum circuits. Participants will receive one or more quantum circuits and will be asked to optimize them while preserving the required computational behaviour or output. The challenge may involve reducing unnecessary gates, lowering circuit depth, improving gate usage, simplifying equivalent operations, and considering practical hardware constraints. Participants are expected to work with concepts such as quantum gates, circuit depth, qubit operations and Qiskit-based circuit construction. The event tests whether participants can move beyond simply writing a circuit and instead reason about how a circuit can be made more efficient and execution-friendly. A short qualifier or sample optimization task can be used to verify readiness before the main challenge. Evaluation can consider correctness, degree of optimization, resource usage, technical reasoning and compliance with stated constraints. The challenge is suitable for participants who have basic exposure to quantum circuits and Python/Qiskit and want to apply those concepts in a practical setting.
